mapper.sql: s.id, s.script_id, s.dm_name, s.start_time, s.capacity, s.status, s.created_at, sc.name AS script_name, sc.genre AS genre, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registrations r WHERE r.session_id = s.id AND r.status = 'REGISTERED') AS registered_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registrations r WHERE r.session_id = s.id AND r.status = 'WAITLISTED') AS waitlist_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sessions (script_id, dm_name, start_time, capacity, status, created_at) VALUES (#{scriptId}, #{dmName}, #{startTime}, #{capacity}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'SCHEDULED'), #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, script_id, dm_name, start_time, capacity, status, created_at FROM sessions WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sessions s JOIN scripts sc ON sc.id = s.script_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
